customset-mv7yibh6-dl43np.front: What is a filtration given a probability space $(\Omega, \mathcal{F}, \mathbb{P})$?
customset-mv7yibh6-dl43np.back: A family of $\sigma$-algebras $(\mathcal{F}_n)_{n \ge 0}$ such that $\mathcal{F_n} \subseteq \mathcal{F_{n+1}} \subseteq \mathcal{F} \quad \forall n$
A family of random variables $(X_n)_{n \ge 0})$ where $X: \Omega \to \mathbb{R}$

customset-mv7yibh6-dl43np.front: What does it mean for a random process $(X_n)_{n \ge 0}$ to be adapted?
customset-mv7yibh6-dl43np.back: $\forall n, X_n \text{ is } F_n \text{-measurable}$. If no filtration is specified, the natural filtration is assumed.

customset-mv7yibh6-dl43np.front: What does it mean for a random variable $X_n$ to be $\mathcal{F}$-measurable?
customset-mv7yibh6-dl43np.back:
If for every $A \in \mathbb{B(R)}$, $\{\omega \in \Omega :  X_n(\omega) \in A\} \in \mathbb{\mathcal{F}}$

where the Borel Set is the collection of all subsets of $\Omega$ including all countable unions/intersections and all complements.

customset-mv7yibh6-dl43np.front: What is the natural filtration of $(X_n)_{n\ge 0}$?
customset-mv7yibh6-dl43np.back:
The natural filtration is the smallest filtration making $(X_n)$ adapted. It is constructed as $$
F_n^X = \sigma (X_k : 0 \le k \le n) = \sigma (X_0, X_1,\dots , X_n)$$

customset-mv7yibh6-dl43np.front: What properties are required to make $X_n$ martingale?
customset-mv7yibh6-dl43np.back:
$\forall n \\$a) $X_n$ is $\mathcal{F}_n$-measurable $\\$
b) $X_n$ is integrable $\iff \mathbb{E}(|X_n|) < \infty \\$
c) $\forall A \in \mathcal{F}_n, \mathbb{E}(X_{n+1}1_A = \mathbb{E}(X_n 1_A))$

Has the other martingale properties and
$$\mathbb{E}(X_{n+1}1_A) \le \mathbb{E}(X_n 1_A)$$
